gaps.sentence: We ___ money by cycling to work instead of driving.
gaps.hint: to keep money instead of spending it
gaps.explanation: 'Save money by doing something' means to avoid spending it; 'earn' means to receive money for work.

gaps.sentence: Please be ___ — the baby is sleeping.
gaps.explanation: 'Quiet' means making little or no noise; 'quite' is an adverb meaning fairly or completely.

gaps.sentence: The ___ issue of the magazine has an interview with the president.
gaps.explanation: 'Current' means happening or existing now; 'actual' means real as opposed to possible or estimated.

gaps.sentence: The medicine had an immediate ___ on her pain.
gaps.hint: a noun is needed after 'an immediate'
gaps.explanation: 'Effect' is the noun meaning result; the fixed phrase is 'have an effect on something'.
'Especially' means in particular or above all; 'specially' means for one particular purpose.

gaps.sentence: The committee will ___ your application at its May meeting.
gaps.explanation: The finite verb slot needs 'consider'; 'considerable' means large.

gaps.sentence: The ___ cost was much higher than the estimate.
gaps.explanation: 'Actual' means real or existing in fact; 'current' means belonging to the present time.

gaps.sentence: He is very ___ to criticism and takes it personally.
gaps.hint: easily affected or hurt; pattern: ___ to
gaps.explanation: 'Sensitive to something' means easily affected or upset by it; 'sensible' means showing good judgement.
